name: High Power Voltage Rule
description: If 15 HP Motor is selected, then 415 V Power must be selected.

name: Sensor Controller Dependency
description: If Sensor is selected, then a Controller is required.

name: Stainless Steel Premium Surcharge
description: If Stainless Steel is chosen, premium pricing susharge applies.

name: Advanced Controller Mounting Kit Requirement
description: If Advanced Controller is selected, Mounting Kit is required.

name: Low Voltage 15HP Incompatibility
description: 15 HP Motor and 230 V Power combination is INVALID.
